title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode10 A Blue Stage

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It looks like Minori is feeling better.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm so glad!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was a little worried about how sad she looked when she got here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But she was smiling by the end! It sure made me happy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Minori always seems more like herself when she's excited and positive about something!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I sure hope Haruka will start smiling again soon.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too. The next time she's here, I hope we're able to help cheer her up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure everything will be fine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Minori is always trying her absolute best!
If anyone can get her to smile again, it's her!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're right! I'm sure Minori can do it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And once they all find their true feelings, we'll all be able to sing their song together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I can't wait to hear what kind of song their feelings will create♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Before that, I really want Haruka to see the ocean of blue glow sticks again, though.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We'll just have to help Minori and the others however we can!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Wait...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Minori and the others?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does that mean you think Airi and Shizuku are going to help with the show for Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yep!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If Minori agrees and says she wants to do the show, I have a feeling Airi and Shizuku will want to get up on stage with her as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're both idols, after all. I'm sure they want to see Haruka happy again too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're right. And with Airi and Shizuku helping, this is sure to be a splendid show!
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The next time they're here, we'll have all sorts of things to discuss, then.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Like choreography and what kind of performance they want to put on! Hehe! I'm getting excited just thinking about it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's a good point. If it were me, I'd choose something that matches the mood of the blue glow sticks.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Tying their performance in to the crowd's actions is a wonderful idea!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We could rig the stage lights to turn blue.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It might be pretty to mount disco balls and have them reflect blue lights down on Minori and the others while they're singing, too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How about releasing blue confetti when their song reaches its crescendo?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, a shower of blue confetti would really make the stage sparkle!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course, the most important thing is to help Minori and the others put on their show however they think is best.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If they have any trouble coming up with ideas, we can offer them some of ours.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin, our job is to make sure their show is a great success!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right! Let's make it happen!
